pages.title: Power Condensation Game
pages.text: In Power Condensation, the goal of the game is to fill each panel with the correct amount of dots, using a Power Analyzer to view the needed quality as well as to select a block to transfer dots from. Your open hand is used to select the block to transfer dots to. Dots are transfered either until the block is full or the donor block is empty.

pages.title: Power analyzer
pages.text: Item used to view the current progress of the blocks as well as mark a block to give dots.

pages.title: Clovinite Power Bank
pages.text: Using 4 of these to start the game starts the version of the game that rewards a Power Blade.

pages.title: Power Blade
pages.text: A Power Blade is given for succesfully completing the game when started with 4 Clovinite Power Banks.

pages.title: Reinforced Blade
pages.text: Using 1 of these to start the game starts the version of the game that rewards a Microstorage Power Cluster.

pages.title: Microstorage Power Cluster
pages.text: A Microstorage Power Cluster is given for succesfully completing the game when started with a Reinforced Blade.
